:::{#hero-heading}
Kihyun Han is a Ph.D. candidate in Statistics at Pennsylvania State University, advised by
Dr. [Yanyuan Ma](https://sites.psu.edu/yanyuanma/). He received his
B.S. in Mathematical Sciences and Statistics (double major) from Seoul National University
in 2022.

His research is primarily methodological, developing semiparametric and
nonparametric methods for inference when a covariate is right-censored, as well
as predictive inference and robustness under distribution shift. He is also interested in applications to biomedical studies and to the social
sciences, including political science and economics. His current applied work
centers on Huntington disease studies, in ongoing collaboration with Dr. [Tanya P.
Garcia](https://tpgarcia.github.io/).

## Research Interests

- Semiparametric modeling
- Nonparametric modeling
- Survival analysis
- Predictive inference
- Distribution shift

## Education

- Ph.D. Statistics, Pennsylvania State University (expected 2027)
- B.S. Mathematical Sciences and Statistics (double major), Seoul National University, 2022
:::
